About Conservation Trips & Adventures

Uganda's premier safari company — crafting life-changing East Africa journeys since 2008

Our Story

Pioneering Conservation Tourism in Uganda

Conservation Trips and Adventures is Uganda's premier safari and adventure travel company. Since 2008, we have been crafting life-changing experiences — with a dedication to excellence, safety, and conservation at our core.

As a fully-fledged travel, tourism and conservation management company, we cater for both regional and global clients. We are proudly local, deeply knowledgeable, and absolutely passionate about sharing Uganda's extraordinary natural and cultural heritage with the world.

Our team of certified guides, naturalists, and logistics specialists combine insider knowledge with international service standards — ensuring every journey exceeds expectations. From selecting the finest lodges to securing sought-after gorilla permits, every detail is handled with expert care.

"Your prime tour and travel partner bringing exceptional experiences in Uganda and beyond."

What Drives Us

Mission, Vision & Values

Our Mission

To provide world-class, sustainable safari and adventure experiences that connect people with Africa's extraordinary wildlife while supporting conservation and local communities.

Our Vision

To be East Africa's most trusted and impactful tour operator — inspiring travellers worldwide to experience the continent's majesty while protecting it for future generations.

Our Values

Conservation first. Integrity always. Excellence in every detail. Community empowerment. Safety without compromise. Authentic experiences over manufactured ones.

Why Choose Us

Since 2008, We've Been Doing This Right

Since 2008, Conservation Trips and Adventures has been creating life-changing safari experiences — with a dedication to excellence, safety, and conservation at our core.

Integrity & Safety

Your safety is our top priority. We meticulously plan every aspect — from transport to accommodation — with rigorous safety protocols and emergency plans in place.

Professional Guides

Embark on a seamless adventure with our knowledgeable and professional guides who bring every destination alive with expertise and passion.

Local Expertise

As a proudly local Ugandan company, we offer an authentic perspective that unlocks hidden gems and cultural insights no outside operator can match.

Exclusive Vehicles

Travel in custom 4x4 safari vehicles with pop-up roofs, USB charging, cooler boxes, and first-aid kits — built for comfort and wildlife viewing.

Tailored Experiences

Your journey, your way. Every safari is customised to align perfectly with your preferences, travel style, group size, and budget.

Sustainable Tourism

We are committed to conservation and responsible tourism — protecting natural resources, wildlife, and the unique cultural heritage of East Africa.
